name: hooks-attribution-guard
description: Advises against AI authorship attribution in git commits so the human stays the sole author of record. Covers agent trailers from any vendor (Co-Authored-By / Signed-off-by / Assisted-by naming Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Devin, aider, Gemini, OpenHands, Windsurf and others, or pointing at an agent noreply address), "Generated with/by" phrases, agent signature URLs, robot-emoji signature lines, and hyphenated AI-assisted/AI-generated qualifiers. Emits a non-blocking advisory (allow + additionalContext, exit 0); a commit message is trivially fixable, so it never blocks. Scoped to authorship constructs, so ordinary work that merely names an agent or a model ("fix AI model loading bug", "bump anthropic sdk") is not flagged. Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).
